title: Unit 29 Consolidation: Cultural Policy and Cultural Institutions in Hungary, 2010–2026
goal: I can sum up the disputes about cultural policy between 2010 and 2026, with the source of each view.
I can report the views about the Petőfi Cultural Agency, theatre funding and the Hungarian Academy of Arts, with the source of each.
I can close an account of cultural policy with the dated facts of the spring of 2026.
